incident-bot: HIGH severity alert — kv_cache_hit_rate (model-serving/us-west) dropped below 0.60 for 3m. Pager: @Alyssa. Auto-created incident INC-2026-122.

Alyssa: Acked — I'm on it. Looking at prom metrics now.

Alyssa: Quick checks: no infra scale events, routing looks normal. Hit rate on the model-serving pool collapsed from ~0.92 to ~0.45 over the last 6m.

Sam: FYI we rolled quantized-llama-v2 yesterday ~23:30 UTC to canary in us-west. Could the key hashing have changed?

Alyssa: Good call. Checking logs for key namespace mismatch and eviction spikes.

Alyssa: Prom query I'm using: `sum by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total{pool="model-serving/us-west"}[5m])) / sum by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total{pool="model-serving/us-west"}[5m]))` — shows 0.46 now.

Matt: Seeing a huge eviction burst at 22:58:07 UTC in the eviction log — 1.2k evictions in a minute, TTLs look normal.

Alyssa: Can we temporarily increase in-memory size for the model-serving pool to reduce churn?

Sam: We can bump cache_max_entries from 200k -> 400k for that pool. Doing a safe route: update config on canary then rollout if green. Applying on canary now.

ops-runbook-bot: Action logged: INC-2026-122 — mitigation step: "bump cache_max_entries" assigned to Sam.

(A few minutes pass)

Sam: Canary change applied. Hit rate climbed to 0.72 within 4m. Rolling to primary nodes now.

Alyssa: Nice. Routing fallback also triggered for some requests earlier (fallback->cpu-hot-cache). That explains partial availability. No error spikes, just latency up ~40ms for fallback flows.

Linda: Any customer-facing impact? I see a small uptick in latency-based SLO alerts for a handful of enterprise tenants. Raising a support ticket to notify them.

Alyssa: Please open a P1 support ticket for affected customers. I will add postmortem notes.

Linda: Created CS-2345 and emailed affected account owners.

Matt: Mitigation summary: increased cache_max_entries for model-serving/us-west, rolled back any problematic canary config if found. No code rollback needed.

Alyssa: Next: we need to tune alerts and add better dashboards to prevent noisy pages and detect eviction storms earlier. Proposed follow-ups:
- New Grafana panel: 1m/5m kv_cache_hit_rate, eviction_rate, avg_ttl, per-model heatmap.
- Change alert thresholds: require 5m sustained hit-rate < 0.70 (was 3m < 0.60) before paging on-call; keep 1m guard for automated alert channel only.
- Add alert: eviction_rate > 1000/min for 2m -> pager to eng-sre, not oncall-first.
- Synthetic canary: periodic key read/write check per pool every 1m.

Sam: Agree. Also add a metric for "cache_key_format_mismatch" (boolean) when key namespace/version mismatches are detected during decode — will help correlate rollout issues.

Alyssa: Can someone paste a sample Prometheus alert rule for the hit-rate change? I'll put it in the runbook.

Matt: Here's an alert draft we used in the past:```yaml
- alert: KVCacheLowHitRate
  expr: (
    sum by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]))
    / sum by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
  ) < 0.70
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Low KV cache hit rate for {{ $labels.pool }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-low-hit-rate"
```

Alyssa: Perfect — I'll add that. Also want an eviction alert:```yaml
- alert: KVCacheEvictionStorm
  expr: rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m]) > 1000
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "High eviction rate in {{ $labels.pool }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-evictions"
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-low-hit-rate (INC-2026-122 follow-up).

Alyssa: For the runbook: add steps — quick triage checklist (check recent deploys -> check eviction_rate -> check key-format metric -> bump cache size or rollback rollout -> route to fallback pool).

Sam: I'll implement `cache_key_format_mismatch` metric and the synthetic key-health check (1m ping). ETA EOD.

Matt: I'll create the Grafana dashboard with the hit-rate heatmap, eviction time-series, and the per-model TTL distribution. Will add folders and share.

Linda: Please include an SLA impact summary for CS in the dashboard so we can pull evidence for customer comms.

Alyssa: Post-incident actions assigned: Sam -> metrics + canary test; Matt -> dashboard + alert rule change; Alyssa -> postmortem + runbook update; Linda -> customer comms.

Alyssa: Handoff to Matt for post-incident monitoring work. I will sign off on-call at 1885123700.

Matt: Taking over. I'll also add a muted alert channel for the 1m noisy guard so it doesn't page.

Alyssa: Thanks everyone — nice quick work. Marking incident as mitigated in INC-2026-122.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident INC-2026-122 status: mitigated. Actions created: RB-987 (runbook update), DASH-430 (grafana dashboard), METRIC-210 (key-format metric).

Linda: Follow-up: please include timeline + root-cause (likely configuration mismatch during quantized-llama-v2 canary) in the postmortem. I'll coordinate customer notes after Alyssa posts the draft. :thumbsup:

Matt: Logged timeline in the incident doc. Will ping when dashboards and alerts are live.

Alyssa: Off-call. Good job team.
